The '''Registry of Noble Houses''' was a registry that listed the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] such as [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].
